jobs.title: Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Role Description
The Fraud Risk Analyst / Financial Crime Analyst is a part-time, remote role responsible for identifying, assessing, and monitoring potential fraud and financial crime risks in client accounts, transactions, and processes. On a day-to-day basis, the analyst reviews data and reports for unusual patterns, conducts investigations into suspicious activities, and documents findings with clear, evidence-based reasoning. The role involves preparing risk assessments, supporting the design or enhancement of controls, and escalating issues according to established protocols. The analyst collaborates with internal stakeholders or client teams, provides concise risk-related insights, and contributes to continuous improvement of fraud detection methodologies and reporting standards.
Qualifications

Strong analytical skills and risk analysis abilities, with experience evaluating complex data and identifying anomalies.
Foundational knowledge of finance and financial systems, including basic understanding of transactions, accounts, and financial products.
Proficiency in statistics and quantitative reasoning to interpret metrics, trend analyses, and model outputs.
Effective communication skills, including clear written reporting and professional, concise verbal communication.
Attention to detail, integrity, and ability to handle sensitive information with discretion.
Comfort working independently in a remote environment, managing time and priorities for part-time schedules.
Experience in fraud risk, financial crime, compliance, or related fields is beneficial.
Relevant education in finance, economics, data analytics, criminal justice, or a related discipline is an advantage.
